headline: Video: Prabowo Wants 70% of State Mining Output, IHSG Plunges to 5,100
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index fell more than 1% to around 5,100 after reports that President Prabowo wants 70% of state-owned mining output. The report was in a CNBC Indonesia video.
why: Indonesia's mining sector is a major source of listed-company revenue, so changes to state revenue rules directly affect investor expectations.
why_moved: The index dropped after reports that President Prabowo wants 70% of state mining output, which raised concerns for mining-linked stocks.
original_headline: Video:Prabowo Mau 70% Hasil Tambang Milik Negara, IHSG Anjlok ke 5.100
